source.name: Her Hoop Stats salary cap sheet

playTypes.label: Spot-up shooter
playTypes.blurb: Catch-and-shoot volume from three, and whether they go in.

playTypes.label: Playmaker
playTypes.blurb: Assists per 36, share of teammate baskets created, and care with the ball.

playTypes.label: Post scorer
playTypes.blurb: Back-to-basket volume, the interior diet around it, finishing, and fouls drawn.

playTypes.label: Driving
playTypes.blurb: Getting to the rim off the bounce — drive and floater volume, finishing, and trips to the line.

playTypes.label: Scoring
playTypes.blurb: Points per 36, the share of possessions used, and true-shooting efficiency.

playTypes.label: Defense
playTypes.blurb: How the team's defense changes with her on the floor, whether the players she guards shoot worse than usual, rim protection, steals, and staying out of foul trouble.

playTypes.label: Rebounding
playTypes.blurb: Rebounds per 36, share of available boards, and work on the offensive glass.
